answer: A farm running 171 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the trellis stake is held until the grove settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the horizon audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 21% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
